name: PIX LIQUIDA
key_symptoms: Pain at a spot about the third left costal cartilage where it joins the rib. Rales through the lungs, and muco-purulent sputum; offensive odor and taste. Chronic bronchitis.
guiding_symptoms: Pain at a spot about the third left costal cartilage where it joins the rib. Rales through the lungs, and muco-purulent sputum; offensive odor and taste. Chronic bronchitis.
respiratory_symptoms: Pain at a spot about the third left costal cartilage where it joins the rib. Rales through the lungs, and muco-purulent sputum; offensive odor and taste. Chronic bronchitis.
skin_symptoms: Cracked; itches intolerably; bleeds on scratching. Eruptions on back of hands.

source.title: PIX LIQUIDA - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
